title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England for review and approval, pursuant to G.L.c. 164, sec. 94 and 220CMR 5.05, of a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Saunstar Operating Co. LLC d/b/a Boston Park Plaza.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: This pricing structure is in accordance with the Department's standard and the Department, therefore, APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protetion from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., W. Robert Keating and Deirdre Manning. (DTE 04-GC-3)
